description: Start a new KYC workflow execution on an existing account. Returns a `redirectUrl` — redirect the end user there to complete the Jumio-hosted capture flow (document + selfie). Poll get_transaction for status afterwards.

accountId.description: Jumio account id returned by initiate_account.

callbackUrl.description: HTTPS callback URL for this workflow's result.

tokenLifetime.description: Lifetime of the redirect token (e.g. '30m', '24h'). Defaults to Jumio's account-level setting.

userReference.description: Opaque reference shown to the user.

web.description: Web channel options, e.g. successUrl / errorUrl to redirect the user to after capture.

workflowDefinition.description: Workflow to run — identified by a numeric `key` configured in the Jumio portal.

key.description: Numeric workflow key (e.g. 200 for ID+selfie, 100 for ID only).

name: initiate_transaction
